regions.merged_text: atheism as most woefully wanting in intelligence; and consequently, whatever his tallents or brilliance my be otherwise, must rate him as an unqualified fool. The most fearful example of such insane want of appredation and of such damnable ingratitude, is that of Lucifer and his reprobate legions, where-Heaven itself was depop- ulated and Hell's creation was made necessary - the most terrible prison-asylum ever designed or conceived. If the primary purpose of my creation as a rational crea- ture is to know my Creator so that I can love Him and serve Him and be happy with Him; amd if according to Holy Writ, no one but a fool can say in his heart, "There is no God"; then the necessary conclu- sion would seem to be that God's existence, at least, must be mani- fest, one way or other, to every one who is not a fool; consequent- ly, that every normal person able to think, can and ought to recog- nize his Creator - can and must worship God. And this under pain of losing everything good in the end and of damning his own soul - "cast out out into exterior darkness, where there shall be weep- ing and gnashing of teeth". However, in a matter of such tremendous importance it would be nothing less than positively criminal to be satisfied with the minimum. The foregoing is simply no answer atall to what we ought to have, -- and Please God to what we shall have. In the first place, there is something intrinsically in the very nature of man - and in the very nature of every rational creature -- that instinctively feels its dependence on something greater than itself - on something supernatural. History and philosophy alike prove this beyond the shadow of an honest doubt, -- to say nothing of common sense; or of theology, the queen of all sciences, so much so, in fact, that to question it seriously, would be to intimate atheism again or a denial of God's existence which accord- ing to all sciences is nothing less than an insult, not only to honest reason to every normal generation back to our, Adam and Eve, but a most flagrant ignoring of Holy Scripture, and of divine re- velation and of Gods own supreme Majesty, Who admonishes, Who pleads, Who commands: ". . . I AM THE LORD THY GOD . . . THOU SHALT LOVE THE LORD THY GOD WITH THY WHOLE HEART AND WITH THY WHOLE SOUL AND WITH ALL THY MIND AND WITH ALL THY STRENGTH . . LET NOT THE WISE MAN GLORY IN HIS WISDOM, AND LET NOT THE STRONG MAN GLORY IN HIS STRENGTH, AND LET NOT THE RICH MAN GLORY IN HIS RICHES: BUT LET HIM THAT GLORIETH GLORY IN THIS, THAT HE UNDERSTANDETH AND KNOWETH ME, FOR I AM THE LORD THAT EXERCISE MERCY AND JUDGEMENT AND JUSTICE IN THE EARTH: FOR THESE THINGS PLEASE ME, SAITH THE LORD". (Example: The graduate from Calcutta) "Dr" Schroeder (unfinished draft)
